label_policy: Labels received assistant content review, deterministic corpus-identity validation, and project-owner confirmation. This is retrieval-ground-truth review, not automated semantic claim-to-citation validation.

retrieval_benchmark.metric_definition: Article-level Recall@K is the fraction of labeled relevant articles found in the first K unique article results; hit@K records whether any relevant article was found; MRR and nDCG@10 use the first 10 unique article results.

generation_contract.boundary: These are deterministic contract checks with mocked provider responses, not live model-quality results.

evaluation_boundary: This manifest defines offline retrieval cases and metadata. It does not contain generated answers, semantic citation judgments, or calibrated retrieval-score thresholds.
